research_question: How do major stock market crashes compare when measured consistently, and where does 2026 fit?

research_brief.purpose: Compare 1929, 1987, 2008, 2020, 2022 and 2026 by measurement type using primary historical and data sources.
research_brief.audience: Readers comparing the 2026 selloff with past crashes.
research_brief.data_period: October 2026 monthly returns and daily closes through November 6, 2026.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Slickcharts, AP and Reuters blocked automated access; annual figures use the Damodaran series instead.
